required_tools.name: python3.11+
required_tools.description: Python 3.11 or later (stdlib only — no pip packages needed). Used by the decathlon_api.py script for OAuth2 PKCE authentication and HTTP requests. BMAD's own resolve_customization.py also needs 3.11+ for stdlib `tomllib`, but it is provisioned through `uv` rather than a system interpreter.

required_tools.name: uv
required_tools.description: uv — fast Python package/project manager. REQUIRED as of BMAD-METHOD 6.11.0: every rendered BMAD skill invokes its Python scripts through `uv run` (all 25 resolve_customization.py call sites were migrated from `python3` upstream), and uv provisions the Python 3.11+ those scripts need.
